notes.title: Status: ONLINE - Patch Notes - Neon Dragon Edition - July 21 at 7AM PDT / 2PM GMT
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/07/Steam_NeonDragon_05.jpg[/IMG]

[b]Update 2:[/b] 
Thanks for your patience, everyone! We're online and ready to go.

Update 1:
Hey all, we're extending our downtime and I wanted to let you know why: all of the additional data being generated this week has lead to a few issues. 

The solution is to upgrade our database hardware. We're in the process of doing that now, and part of that process is to back up all of our data. With a data backup, if anything goes wrong, you won't lose any progress.

However, one of the other side effects of all this new data is a much longer than anticipated backup period. Specifically today we're going to need to add a few hours to our downtime in order to make sure all the data is backed up correctly. 

We apologize, and know you were looking forward to the servers coming up. This will result in a much smoother and more stable Trove, and we'll bring the servers back as soon as possible. Thanks!


We will be performing maintenance and [URL=http://forums.trovegame.com/showthread.php?32351-Neon-Dragons-Edition]rolling out a patch on 7/21/2015[/URL]. 

The servers will come down at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PDT+July+21+2015] 7 AM PDT / 2 PM GMT[/URL] and should be down for approximately 6 hours. 

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*]You can now earn Neon Dragon Caches from challenges, or purchase them on the store! 
[*]Neon Dragon Caches have an uncommon chance of dropping Neon Dragon Souls, and have a rare chance of dropping Dragon Coins.
[*]Dragon Coins can be used to craft previous dragon souls as well as for forging. 
[*]There are now more levels of rewards for dragon progression! 
[*]Since souls are more common, the required amount to max your progression has been set to 100. 
[*]The chance to get 1000 Flux or 50 Eyes of Q'bthulhu from Neon Dragon Caches is slightly lower than it was with Azulian Dragon Caches. 
[*]Crafting the Azulian Dragon Soul with Azulian Dragon Essences no longer requires a Dragon Coin as well as essences: it now costs 4x Essences and Glacial Shards. 
[*]There is now a recipe which costs 2x Dragon Coins and Glacial Shards. 
[*]In the future Dragon Coins will be usable to get other out of rotation Dragon Souls.
[/list]

[h1]NEW IN THE STORE[/h1]
[list]
[*]Chaos Chests have been randomized! This week’s contents include some hard to find mounts.
[/list]

[h1]MECHANICS[/h1]
[list]
[*]All boats now accelerate faster when not turning. 
[*]NPCs should no longer get pushed around by Tomb Raiser minions. 
[*]Friends are now visible through walls from further away, using a different color. 
[/list]
[h1]ADVENTURING[/h1] 
[list]
[*]Earthly Dragon Adventurer Chests no longer drop. 
[*]They have been replaced with Panda Adventurer Chests, which have a chance of containing the rare Giant Red Panda or Giant Fae Panda mounts, designed by FriedSushi! 
[*]The Neon City biome now shows up as a challenge biome.
[/list]
[h1]UI AND SETTINGS[/h1] 
[list]
[*]The equipment comparison tooltip now shows correct difference for percentage based stat modifiers. 
[*]Added rules to select an acceptable default Fullscreen resolution if none is set when Trove launches.  
[*]Added brightness and gamma controls to video settings. 
[*]Added Whisper to player context menu in chat.  
[*]The map legend now changes based on which world you're currently in. 
[*]The game now mutes sound when it loses focus. 
[*]When making Steam Wallet purchases without the overlay enabled the client now tells you that the overlay must be enabled for that action.  
[*]The chest/loot-box opening UI now closes when the player moves or presses escape, just like all other UI elements!
[/list]
[h1]LOOT[/h1] 
[list]
[*]New uncommon and rare staff styles have been added to the game! 
[*]New Melee styles have been added to the game! 
[*]The granted Shadow Keys which were broken should now work.
[/list]
[h1]CRAFTING[/h1] 
[list]
[*]Crafting can now start a second stack of an item.  
[*]The Elysian Flask refilling station on the starting cornerstone is now lootable. This only affects newly created Cornerstones, not existing ones.
[/list]
[h1]BUG FIXES AND POLISH[/h1] 
[list]
[*]Implemented additional server and database optimizations. 
[*]Fixed a bug where consecutive login stat could get reset when it shouldn't have. Really. 
[*]Neon city "grass" now works like other grass (will spread onto dirt). 
[*]Fixed a bug where grass would sometimes change into the wrong type of dirt. 
[*]The Sky Realm no longer incorrectly displays recipe icons on the worldmap. 
[*]Master Magician and Master Cheep Emblem descriptions no longer incorrectly state they can be bought for cubits or credits from the store, and correctly state they can be obtained by achieving the appropriate Mastery Rank. 
[*]Fixed an issue with Patron Passes not working when changing worlds soon after purchase. 
[*]Fixed a bug where you lose bonus Patron Pass flask changes when changing worlds. 
[*]Fixed a bug where the fog of war would not update correctly. 
[*]Fixed a startup crash. Fixed a bug causing VFX to sometimes not appear. 
[*]Club World maps no longer incorrectly use the dragon biome icon on the map for zones that cannot be modified. 
[*]Fixed the unsightly flickering in the Warhorse and Radiant Steed mount VFX. 
[*]Cursed Skulls no longer break apart when completed. 
[*]Arcanium Crawlers have had their legs made more symmetrical. 
[*]Slightly decreased number of log lines in the club log.  
[*]Three-star dungeons should now use the correct portal on the outside when completed.
[/list]

notes.notes:
Update: To help resolve these hardware issues, we're going to restart the servers to apply some hotfixes. Anyone currently in game will be removed.

We will do our best to keep the remaining down time to a minimum, but we want to make sure that we're running smoothly for everyone before we come back online.


Hello everyone!

The Trove servers are currently locked while we test some issues that were causing lag, and poor game performance for players as new players signed in.

We've posted about this on our forums as well: http://triongam.es/1THrmpC

If we need to take any additional action, we will make sure to post here, as quickly as possible. We're keeping players in game up to date as well, with in game announcements.

Thanks!

notes.title: Update - Trove Server Maintenance
notes.notes:
Update: To help resolve these hardware issues, we're going to restart the servers to apply some hotfixes. Anyone currently in game will be removed.

We will do our best to keep the remaining down time to a minimum, but we want to make sure that we're running smoothly for everyone before we come back online.


Hello everyone!

The Trove servers are currently locked while we test some issues that were causing lag, and poor game performance for players as new players signed in.

We've posted about this on our forums as well: http://triongam.es/1THrmpC

If we need to take any additional action, we will make sure to post here, as quickly as possible. We're keeping players in game up to date as well, with in game announcements.

Thanks!

notes.title: Online - Hotfix - 9:25 AM PDT (-7GMT) July 17th, 2015
notes.notes:
Update #2: We're back online. Thanks again!

Update 1: Due to server issues, we've moved up the restart time by 35 minutes.

Hello everyone!

We will be performing a hotfix and server restart. 

The servers will come down at 9:25 AM PDT / 4:25 PM GMT and should be down for approximately one hour. 

We'll do our best to come in under that.

Thanks for your patience!

notes.title: Update #3 - Trove Server Maintenance - 7/16/2015
notes.notes:
Update #3: Trove is back online. Thanks again for your patience. 

Update #2: We continue to work on making sure that we're able to accommodate everyone comfortably, but we're getting close to bringing the servers online. Please allow up to 1 more hour (12:10 PM PDT / 7:10 PM GMT), but we will do our very best to come in under that.

Hello everyone!

We're restarting the Trove servers due to an issue that prevented some players from getting in game. 

We want to make sure we avoid future issues, so we're doing some investigation before unlocking the servers. The servers should be back online at approximately 11 AM PDT / 6 PM GMT.

We'll do our best to come in under that, but will keep this post updated if there are any changes.

Thanks for your patience!

(Updated original down time estimate)

notes.title: An Update on Queues
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/07/launch_blog_header-720x3221.jpg[/IMG]

The demand for Trove continues to surpass our wildest expectations. We are so grateful to everyone who has played, and to everyone who has told your friends about this game of ours. 

As proud as we are of the game, the queues have continued to be roadblock for many players.

To combat the queues, we've added a ton of new hardware. These new servers combined with code optimizations have enabled us support many more concurrent players, and we'll continue to add new hardware and work on our servers until the queue is no more.

Tonight brought one such server hotfix and the following days will include more.

Thanks so much for all of your support, and your patience. We'll see you in Trove. 

- Steve "Fasti" Haines

notes.title: Trove Queues Update - 7/15/2015
notes.notes:
Hey folks,

We're very happy with the response to Trove since launch, and in an effort to keep up with demand, we've added additional server hardware six times since launch. We're continuing to update our forums with new details several times a day: http://triongam.es/1fxPCvT

The queues are not fun, and we're continuing to take action to improve the situation as quickly as possible. While we do still have queues, another group of servers has been brought online, and we're now working to make sure that players are able to make use of every bit of the new hardware.

Thanks everyone!
